column3: Harbourview Tenants Association | 14 Linden Row | Port Avel PA3 9QD
The Facilities Office Port Avel Borough Council 2 Quay Street Port Avel PA1 4BT
Re: Renewal of the community hall lease
Thank you for your letter of 2 September regarding the community hall on Linden Row. Our members discussed the proposed terms at the general meeting held last Thursday.

The association would like to renew the lease for a further three years. We accept the revised rent, provided that the heating system is serviced before the winter. We would also welcome a meeting to agree a schedule for the repairs to the roof.
Please let us know which dates suit your office in October. We look forward to continuing our work with the council.
Noor Ashdown Secretary, Harbourview Tenants Association
